messages:
maria: Customer reported duplicate provisional charges after reconnecting a streaming session that had an in-flight toolcall TTL expiry.
jon: Can you share repro?
maria: Stream -> toolcall(tc-914) TTLs -> reconnect -> console shows two provisional entries prov-101/prov-102.
kevin: Our resume currently clears the toolcall anchor on TTL, so resume creates a fresh provisional.
sam: Right. We didn't have a way to signal last_toolcall on reconnect, so server treats it as a new append.
jon: Idea: accept resume_hint { last_toolcall: "tc-914", last_offset: 42 } in reconnect API so we can reattach and reuse provisional.
maria: Many customers won't update clients immediately. Need short-term ops mitigation.
jon: UX: add console "Probable duplicate provisional" flag and an ops action to collapse duplicates into one charge.
billing-bot: Alert: prov-101 and prov-102 created for session ssd-99. Suspect resume duplicate.
kevin: Important: reserved capacity billing must not be auto-collapsed. Tag with billing.policy=reserved_override.
sam: Plan: 1) emit metric resume.provisional_dup for 72h, 2) feature-flag console filter + collapse action, 3) pilot resume_hint with internal apps.
jon: I'll draft console copy and a 10% canary that treats recent reconnects as reattach (emit metric for FP rate).
maria: Owners: jon(console), sam(server), kevin(billing telemetry). Support to update KB.
kevin: Timeline: telemetry & FF in 48h, resume_hint pilot next week.
maria: Thanks folks :thumbsup:
